# JetBlack

> > JetBlack provides certified passive fire protection solutions for industrial equipment, pipelines, and critical infrastructure in petrochemical and offshore environments.

JetBlack specializes in flexible and compact passive fire protection (PFP) systems with ISO22899-1 and DNV-GL certifications. The company serves major industrial clients including BASF and Shell, offering custom fire protection for valves, pipes, cable trays, and equipment exposed to hydrocarbon fires.

## Key Topics

- Passive Fire Protection (PFP)
- JetBlack Flexible System
- IGNIS-PFP BOX

## Core Products

- [JetBlack Flexible Protection System](https://www.jetblack-pfp.com/products/jetblack): Flexible passive fire protection system with ISO22899-1 certification for industrial equipment and pipelines
- [IGNIS-PFP BOX](https://www.jetblack-pfp.com/products/ignis-pfp-box): Compact fire protection product for critical equipment with integrated thermal design
- [Product Catalog](https://www.jetblack-pfp.com/products): Complete product line featuring JetBlack Flexible and IGNIS-PFP BOX systems
- [Custom Applications](https://www.jetblack-pfp.com/products/applications): Custom fire protection systems engineered for valves, pipes, and specialized equipment
